issue_context.title: export to blob does not load new fonts
issue_context.body: Export to blob outside the editor (`exportToBlob`, but also `exportToCanvas`), does not load new fonts, as the fonts are not loaded by the `FontFace` API. This does not affect SVG export (as the fonts are fetched manually), nor PNG export inside the editor (as by coincidence fonts are already loaded by the editor), but it does affect `link.excalidraw.com` (i.e. https://app.excalidraw.com/l/6rfy1007QOo/7YLPfH1nMfU). In the following screenshot, we should see `Excalifont`, but instead we see a fallback font.

review_comments: is this in anticipation for registering custom fonts in runtime? Otherwise `Fonts.init().entries()` already gives you all the fonts anyway
